entry.title: PortaPack H4M Pro
entry.summary:
Vendor: OpenSource SDR
Type: RF
Price: 280.00

The PortaPack H4M Pro is a stand-alone, all-in-one portable SDR device based on the latest HackRF Pro framework. The pre-flashed MAYHEM firmware provides vital out-of-the-box functionality for pentesters: Receive / Transmit / Replay / Scan, with dozens of baked in high-level functions: Real-time Spectrum Monitoring, Key-Fob demodulation, ADS-B/AIS, Bluetooth, and much, much more.

This all-in-one device includes the HackRF Pro + PortaPack in a fully-assembled, rugged injection molded ABS case - no extra hardware, cables, modification or soldering required.

While the HackRF One redefined the pentest/hacker community as a completely affordable, hugely capable, open-source SDR device - it required an external computer, software and advanced knowledge to use. The H4M gives you the power of the HackRF - it's still usable directly - but also the flexibility of a compact, rugged device that requires no external devices.

This product is not made by Great Scott Gadgets. The trademark “HackRF” is used by permission.

H4M Pro Advantages

The PortaPack H4M Pro is a truly integrated, truly portable SDR laboratory. Based on the latest HackRF Pro architecture, the Portapack H4M Pro has multiple advantages over previous versions:

  • 1
  • 2
  • 3
  • 4
  • 5
  • 6

1. Remastered Hardware

Increased operating frequency, memory, precision. Improved shielding, better RF performance, on-board FPGA.

2. Expanded Frequency

The H4M Pro now operates natively between 100kHz and 6GHz

3. Integrated TCXO

Use the internal TXCO, or external clocks via the dual clock SMA connectors for synchronising multiple devices.

4. Improved RF Shielding & Antenna Protection

Greatly increased RF Shielding for perfect reception; integrated antenna surge-protection

5. Replacable Battery (included)

The industry-standard 18650 battery can be swapped in seconds - meaning you'll never run out of power.

6. Everything Onboard

Integrated touchscreen, speaker, microphone and tactile navigation wheel for fully untethered operations.

Functionality at a glance

Signal Capture

Easily perform raw signal capture - for instant replay, or for offline demodulation, analysis and modification.

Signal Replay

Oranised and Replay raw signals - directly after capture, or from the SD card or from otther sources.

Signal Detection

Detect and identify the frequency of nearby transmission sources. Useful for reconaissance and identifcation.

Frequency Scanner

Constantly scan a configurable range of frequencies to consecutively or in parallel.

In-built Apps

Dozens of inbuilt applications, such as real-time ADB-S scanner, GPS-Simulator, TPMS decoders.. and more

Signal Generator

Generate customised signals - and even spectrum outputs - for device configuration & testing or even fuzzing.

Custom Apps

Open-source hardware and software and an active community - with support for custom applications.

HackRF Pro Mode

Naturally - you still have direct access to the HackRF - with full support for all common SDR tools - GNU Radio etc.

Detailed functionality

Receive:

  • Sniff & Capture: Sniff & capture easily for instant replay, or save to the SD card for demodulation, analysis and modification.
  • ADS-B: Receive and analyse ADS-B (Aviation) Signals, with the ability to display real-time locations on a map.
  • AIS: Receive and analyse AIS (Marine) Signals
  • AFSK: Receive, demodulate and analyse AFSK Signals
  • Bluetooth: Sniff MAC addresses of BLE devices
  • NRF: Decode NRF24L01 signals, commonly used for drones
  • Audio: Decode WFM/NFM/AM
  • Spectrum Analyser: Waterfall spectrum analyser for detecting signals
  • Analog TV: Decode and watch Analog TV signals, commonly used on FPV drones
  • ERT Meters: Decode ERT Meter signals
  • POCSAG: Sniff and decode pager signals
  • Radiosonde: Sniff and decode RadioSonde signals, commonly used in weather stations
  • TPMS: Decode TPMS sensors (used in car tires)

Transmit:

  • ADS-B: Real-time Capture & Analysis of ADS-B (Aviation) Signals
  • APRS: Capture and craft APRS packets, commonly used for weather stations and other various telemetry
  • GPS: Audit & analyse GPS signals
  • Key Fob: Key-fob capture, replay and emulation for multiple models of remotes
  • Morse Code: Morse code transmission tool
  • Burger Pager: Decode "Burger Pager" (Restaurant pager) signals
  • POCSAG: Send Pager signals
  • SSTV: Send SSTV Signals
  • RDS: Send RDS messages
  • OOK: Send OOK Packages

Device Specifications

  • Screen: LCD Touch Screen
  • Tactile Controls: Arrow Keys, Rotary Wheel, Select Buttons
  • Headphone / Mic Socket: 3.5mm headphone / microphone jack
  • Internal Coin Battery: Coin battery for RTC & Settings storage
  • MicroSD Card Slot: For data import / export
  • Case: Transluscent ABS
  • Battery: 18650 (Included)

What's included

  • 1x PortaPack H4M Pro (HackRF Pro + PortaPack H4M Pro v1.2.1)
  • 1x 18650 Rechargeable Li-ion Battery (9250mWh, Replaceable)
  • 1x USB-A to USB-C 3.0 Cable
  • 1x 75MHz - 1GHz Telescopic Antenna
  • 1x 40MHz - 6GHz Telescopic Antenna

Compatible Systems

  • Windows/macOS/Linux/Android (Specific Builds)
  • GNU Radio / GQRX / SDR#, SDR Console, Universal Radio Hacker etc

WARNING ⚠️ Understand your responsibilities

The PortaPack H4M is a wide-band radio device, with transceiver capabilities.
The EU Radio Equipment Directive (2014/53/EU) Annex I places custom-built evaluation kits outside its scope for professional use in research and development contexts.

Restrictions for transmitting and receiving vary. You are responsible for ensuring that your possession and use of these devices complies with the law in your jurisdiction.

Receiving: Several countries restrict monitoring outside broadcast and amateur allocations, and a few restrict what you may do with what you hear. Check the rules where you are before you tune.

Transmitting: Transmit only on bands you are licensed for, at or below the power your license and national regulations allow. Where you hold no license for a band, work with a dummy load, a shielded enclosure, or a cabled and attenuated link so that nothing reaches the air.

WARNING ⚠️ Before you tune or transmit

Never tune or transmit your device without an antenna or balanced dummy load. Doing so can permanently damage your device and void your warranty. Please refer to the below videos for further information on how to appropriately setup your device.

entry.title: KrakenSDR
entry.summary:
Vendor: KrakenRF
Type: SDR
Price: 1020.00

KrakenSDR is dedicated solution for Radio Direction Finding / Signal Tracking.

Leveraging 5 "coherently linked" interal SDR circuits, the KrakenSDR and included desktop & mobile software allow effortless signal locking, finding and tracking from 100MHz - 1GHz.

Purpose-built for signal tracking, the included antennas can be mounted on a car roof; turn-by-turn navigation is provided automatically by the Android application.

The KrakenSDR is OpenSource : power users have full control over all radio settings, software and firmware. Users can even control each radio circuit individually for simultaneous multi-band monitoring.

Powerful Desktop Tools

Passively capture low, full and high-speed USB traffic and up to 16 related digital signals simultaneously for analysis.

Signal Tracking App

Full-featured open-source tools for capturing, filtering, visualising and analysing USB-traffic on a protocol level.

Auto-Calibration

No-manual time-consuming, complex calibration - works out of the box.

Rugged Design

High-quality metal body provides solid protection and passive cooling.

KrakenSDR : Track Down Radio Transmitters

Introduction into tracking down signals with KrakenSDR by sn0ren. Theory, basics, setup and practical demonstration of live signal tracking with the KrakenSDR platform.

Key Features

  • Five coherent RTL-SDR units, clocked to the same single oscillator.
  • Automatic coherence synchronisation hardware & software
  • 24 MHz to 1766 MHz Range (extendable with alternative drivers)
  • 4.5 V bias tee on each port
  • Open-Source Desktop & Mobile Applications

Key Uses

  • Transmitter Locating - Signals of interest, noise sources, illegal broadcasts
  • Asset Tracking - Wildlife, tagged animals or tagged assets.
  • Search & Rescue - Real-time location & tracking of emergency beacons
  • Fox Hunting - Radio operator training & experiments
  • Open Source - 100% open-source software, firmware, gateware and hardware.

Device Specifications

  • RX Channels: 5
  • Radio Tuner: 5x R820T2
  • Radio ADC: 5x RTL2832U
  • ADC Bit Depth: 8-bits
  • Frequency Range: 24 MHz - 1766MHz (extendable via alternative drivers)
  • Maximum Channel Bandwidth: 2.56MHz

  • Dimensions: 177 x 112 x 25mm
  • Weight: 670g
  • Power Consumption: 11W ( 2.2A @ 5v )

What's included

  • 1x KrakenSDR
  • 5x Official Tuned Antennas + Cables

Please note: The KrakenRF processing software needs to be run on a separate device. Images for the Raspberry PI 4 & 5 are available.
